question.text: If coupon > YTM, bond trades at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.66 states that when a bond's market price is more than its face value, the bond sells at a premium and the YTM is less than the coupon rate. Equivalently, coupon greater than YTM implies the bond trades at a premium. The Trap: The opposite relationship (coupon less than YTM) is what produces a discount. Note: Par occurs when coupon equals YTM.
